rationale: The agent executed an exchange for the thermostat without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm any order-changing action. It also selected a “black” variant without user approval and provided an unsubstantiated claim about a price-difference refund. The user’s conditional keyboard request (clicky, RGB, full-size; otherwise only thermostat) was not addressed—no evidence of availability check, confirmation, or explicit decision communicated. While user lookup and some product lookups were attempted, the key failures are (1) performing a write without confirmation, (2) not fully addressing the keyboard condition, and (3) stating information not supported by tool outputs. Therefore, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
